text:
Predicates:
GainsKnowledge(x) ::: x gains knowledge.
Smarter(x) ::: x is smarter.
Reads(x, y) ::: x reads y.
Book(y) ::: y is a book.
Author(y, z) ::: y is authored by z.
Premises:
Reads(harry, walden) ∧ Author(walden, henryThoreau) ::: Harry read the book 'Walden' by Henry Thoreau.
GainsKnowledge(x) → Smarter(x) ::: Gaining knowledge makes a person smarter.
Conclusion:
GainsKnowledge(harry) ::: Harry gains knowledge.
